, NVL(A.BUYER_TARGET_PRICE,0) AS PREV_DEAL_PRICE , #{P_BUYER} , A.CMS_CATEG_ID , #{INIT_PROCESS_TYPE} , #{CMS_CATLG_ID} , #{ORIGIN_CODE} , CASE WHEN #{INIT_PROCESS_TYPE} = '0' THEN '' WHEN mapper.update: INSERT INTO BNTNEGOHISTORY ( /*insertNegoHistoryRqdt*/ BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , REVISION , NEGO_SEQ , NEGO_PRICE , NEGO_DATE , BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , BTOA_NEGO_REMARK , CREATE_USER_ID , ATOB_UNIT_PRICE ) ( SELECT BUYER , QUOTATION_NO , QUOTATION_SEQ , REVISION , (SELECT NVL(MAX(NEGO_SEQ)+1,1) FROM BNTNEGOHISTORY NGHIS WHERE NGHIS.BUYER = A.BUYER AND NGHIS.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND NGHIS.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND NGHIS.REVISION = A.REVISION ) AS NEGO_SEQ , #{ATOB_UNIT_PRICE} , SYSDATE , BTOA_NEGO_PRICE , REJECT_REMARK , #{st_user_id} , (SELECT ATOB_UNIT_PRICE FROM KEPQTDT B WHERE AGENT_REVISION =( SELECT MAX(AGENT_REVISION) FROM KEPQTDT C WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = C.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = C.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION AND C.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND C.STATUS = 'O' ) AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO = B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = B.QUOTATION_SEQ AND A.REVISION = B.REVISION AND BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' AND STATUS = 'O' ) FROM KEPRQDT A WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} AND REVISION = #{REVISION} )
